chunks: O you who believe, let not your wealth and children make you negligent of the remembrance of God. Those who do so will be losers.
ai.seo_question: How do wealth and children distract believers from remembering God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the hypocrites who outwardly professed faith but allowed material prosperity and progeny to distract them from spiritual obligations, particularly prayer and charity. It underscores the principle that worldly blessings are tests rather than ends, warning that true loss lies in prioritizing temporal assets over the remembrance of Allah (dhikr). This serves as a practical guide for believers to maintain spiritual vigilance amidst worldly success.
